scope: WebXR nominal cadence reporting and target-rate lifecycle
behavior: Initialize a known nominal frame rate before the XRSession request promise resolves.
Report DomeD runtime cadence independently of author-controlled target rates; inline and unknown rates remain null.
Apply meaningful compositor-rate changes before matching animation callbacks and while hidden callbacks are paused.
Suppress events caused only by nanosecond period quantization and retain known metadata through temporarily unavailable periods.
Keep historical action periods from replacing current compositor cadence.
Reject invalid backend rate responses while preserving metadata, concurrent promise ownership and reentrant shutdown behavior.

live_samples: Discord login and X landing retain the accepted rendering baseline, survive 30 seconds and close cleanly
validation.historical_period_extension: Only the two native cadence fixture runs were repeated after adding the historical-action case; compiled production sources stayed unchanged.

deployment: Uses the existing DomeD period field and preserves running desktop, browser and XR sessions.
limitations: Portable OpenXR rate adapter methods type-check against locked OpenXR 0.21.1; Windows graphics and physical-device behavior were not exercised.
The independent shader-validator test remains ignored; broader supported API/backend/device coverage and later rendering work remain.
